intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Madhya Pradesh where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh: IIM Indore and MANIT Bhopal.

These are the MBA colleges in Madhya Pradesh with ₹50 lakh highest package in our file. IIM Indore leads the top MBA colleges in Madhya Pradesh 2026, now on its official 2025 PGP card, not an older IPM-only row.
listLead: IIM Indore and MANIT Bhopal are both public institutes, in Indore and Bhopal. Compare the five-year IPM, the two-year PGP and the NIT MBA as different programmes.
snapshot: IIM Indore's official Final Placement Report 2025 for the PGP and IPM class of 2023-25 lists an average CTC of ₹29.57 LPA, a median of ₹27 LPA and a highest domestic offer of ₹70 LPA. That is the row which now meets this threshold.
MANIT Bhopal's MBA row for 2023 shows an average of ₹11 LPA and a highest of ₹82 LPA in our file. The gap between those two numbers is wide, so the official report matters more than the headline.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Indore is 8th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. MANIT Bhopal is not in that top 100, so do not treat a high offer there as a substitute for a current official report.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures in Madhya Pradesh
paragraphs: An integrated IPM at IIM Indore and an MBA at MANIT Bhopal have different entry routes, including IPMAT and CAT. Match the placement report to the programme you can actually join.
bullets: Check whether the figure is for the IPM, the two-year PGP or the NIT MBA.

Use the official average beside the highest; IIM Indore's official 2025 highest domestic offer is ₹70 LPA, and the official average is ₹29.57 LPA. MANIT Bhopal's recorded 2023 highest should still be checked in its official report.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Madhya Pradesh with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} public colleges: IIM Indore and MANIT Bhopal. IIM Indore now qualifies on the official 2025 PGP and IPM combined report (average ₹29.57 LPA, highest domestic ₹70 LPA). MANIT Bhopal remains on a 2023 MBA record in our file.

faqs.question: What is IIM Indore's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: IIM Indore is 8th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. The official 2025 report covers the PGP and IPM class together, with an average of ₹29.57 LPA and a highest domestic offer of ₹70 LPA. Match the official report to the programme you will join.

faqs.question: Is a ₹114 Lakh highest package typical at IIM Indore?
faqs.answer: No. In the same 2024 IPM row, the average is ₹30 LPA. The highest is a single top offer and should be confirmed in the official placement report.

faqs.question: How should I read MANIT Bhopal's ₹82 Lakh highest package?
faqs.answer: It sits beside a 2023 average of ₹11 LPA in our records. That gap is large, so use the official MBA placement report rather than the highest figure alone.
